name: data_get
description: get a scoped app entity through REST. Data is included on reads. Writes require the expected version and an operation ID for safe retries.

name: data_list
description: list a scoped app entity through REST. Data is included on reads. Writes require the expected version and an operation ID for safe retries.

name: data_upsert
description: upsert a scoped app entity through REST. Data is included on reads. Writes require the expected version and an operation ID for safe retries.

name: data_patch
description: patch a scoped app entity through REST. Data is included on reads. Writes require the expected version and an operation ID for safe retries.

name: data_delete
description: delete a scoped app entity through REST. Data is included on reads. Writes require the expected version and an operation ID for safe retries.

name: forms_list
description: List enabled tenant/environment forms and their versions.

name: submission_status
description: List submissions owned by the configured customer session. A reference alone grants no access.

name: draft_get
description: Read an owned saved draft, photo completion and private history.

name: draft_discard
description: Permanently delete an owned draft and its photos. Submitted records cannot be deleted. Requires the current revision.

name: submission_inbox
description: Read submitted forms. Requires tenant owner/admin authentication.

name: submission_review
description: Review a submission and write a submitter-visible message with optimistic concurrency.

name: submission_analytics
description: Read deduplicated first-party counts grouped by source, medium and campaign.

name: forms_settings
description: Read tenant forms enablement and definitions.

name: forms_configure
description: Install immutable form versions and enable/disable submissions for this tenant environment.
